title: crm.pipeline.deal.created
description: A deal was opened, by a person or by lead conversion. `stage` is a stage key of the organization's pipeline and never changes meaning; `stage_outcome` (open, won or lost) is what a consumer tests, because beyond the six stages a pipeline starts with, the keys are the organization's own. `owner_id` is the column deal's OWN scope compares with the caller's subject reference. `created_at` is the row's own creation time; an import may backdate it, so it can differ from the envelope's `occurred_at`. `closed_at` is non-null only for a deal created directly in a won or lost stage.
